title: The American Practical Navigator, Volume II, 2019, NGA Publication 9

findings.locator: printed p303, Atlantic North Equatorial Current entry spanning both columns
findings.finding: The glossary describes origin near26W across15N-30N, continuing west beyond60W and feeding Antilles and Caribbean branches.
findings.admissible_use: Source-specific geographic origin and connection context; possible longitude gates for a separately defined regional diagnostic.
findings.limits: The origin latitude band is not a current width or a centerline. Beyond60W is not a terminal endpoint. No alongflow length, depth, observation date, physical boundaries or annual range is reported. A chosen mid-latitude line would be an editorial construction, not a measured current axis.

findings.locator: printed p334, East Africa Coastal Current entry spanning both columns
findings.finding: The entry extends seasonal-reversal discussion into the Northern Hemisphere and explicitly also names the Somali Current.
findings.limits: Do not treat this broad glossary scope as the modern EACC alone, transfer Somali reversal phases into its seasonal metadata, or join10S-to4N as a whole-EACC axis.

disposition: Retained source-scope review only; no dimensions, identity aliases or scientific collection rows admitted. Original PDF and selected renders remain private review evidence.
